mod:ros2_ws/src/lattice_bridge/test/test.explain: Tests for bridge_core.py (31 test functions), feeding it a script of events with a fake clock: the drone is published about once a second and only for a newer position; sea-level height is corrected but ellipsoid height is not; a silent link stops the updates without repeating a position and the not_live policy marks the drone offline once; one target reported many times stays one entity and a report between two targets merges them; a release without a position is only counted; invalid entities never reach the output; a broken event or output cannot stop the bridge; shutdown says goodbye once; run_loop stops at 'ended' or when asked. No sockets, threads or ROS.
mod:ros2_ws/src/lattice_bridge/test/test.how_it_fits: Part of the package's pytest suite.

mod:ros2_ws/src/lattice_bridge/test/test.explain: End-to-end tests of the bridge program (22 test functions): a made-up simulator run folder is replayed through the real source, core, publisher and sinks into a JSONL file and into the fake Lattice over real sockets (the drone is taken off at the end); a wrong token loses nothing the bridge could keep; the dry run prints the plan and never a secret; the exit codes for a missing run folder (4), a missing folder setting, address or token (3), a fast replay into Lattice, a mistyped profile key (3) and a bad flag (2); the secret log filter; and PublisherOut. No ROS, simulator or internet.
mod:ros2_ws/src/lattice_bridge/test/test.how_it_fits: Part of the package's pytest suite.

mod:ros2_ws/src/lattice_bridge/test/test.explain: Tests for clustering.TargetClusterer (39 test functions): two photos of one target merge and two targets stay apart; a person and a tent never mix; the 12 m radius boundary; the nearest target wins; best confidence wins; the position is the confidence-squared weighted mean and a poor outlier cannot drag it far; quiet updates (1 m / +0.02); clusters that grow together merge, the older id survives and ids are never reused; bad data is ignored with a reason; memory is bounded by the cluster limit; sightings across the 180-degree line merge; and the result does not depend on arrival order.
mod:ros2_ws/src/lattice_bridge/test/test.how_it_fits: Part of the package's pytest suite.

mod:ros2_ws/src/lattice_bridge/test/test.how_it_fits: Part of the package's pytest suite.

mod:ros2_ws/src/lattice_bridge/test/test.how_it_fits: Part of the package's pytest suite.

mod:ros2_ws/src/lattice_bridge/test/test.explain: Tests for build_area_geo and build_drop_point (17 test functions): the documented geo-entity shape (TEMPLATE_GEO, geoDetails, geoShape, no milView, never noExpiry), closed counter-clockwise polygons even from clockwise input, the control-area type for the flight boundary, unknown geo types and bad polygons, names and times refused, the retire (isLive false) update, and drop points at the release position with an optional height that is never invented.
mod:ros2_ws/src/lattice_bridge/test/test.how_it_fits: Part of the package's pytest suite.

mod:ros2_ws/src/lattice_bridge/test/test.explain: Tests for build_target_track (19 test functions): every required part; the location is the projected target, never the drone; no altitude is invented; the confidence lives in the description and in trackQualityWrapper; sourceUpdateTime is the measurement time, never 'now'; createdTime is the first sighting; the expiry is mission end plus margin and under 30 days; bad kinds, positions, sighting counts and naive or future times are refused; rounding keeps about a millimetre; random valid inputs always validate.
mod:ros2_ws/src/lattice_bridge/test/test.how_it_fits: Part of the package's pytest suite.

mod:ros2_ws/src/lattice_bridge/test/test.explain: Tests for build_uav_asset (36 test functions): exactly the required parts and nothing invented; sourceUpdateTime is the fix time; the rolling 120 s expiry; the goodbye update; HAE = AMSL + geoid undulation (AMSL used as HAE with a note when unset, and 0 counts as set); AGL from the relative altitude; the heading quaternion; NED to ENU velocity; mode and armed text; battery and link thresholds rolled up to the worst; connectionStatus left to Lattice; and bad or random inputs either raise ValueError or produce a valid entity, never anything else.

fn:ros2_ws/src/lattice_bridge/lattice_br.explain: Answers one PUT, in this order, with exactly one journal line per outcome stamped with the arrival time: read the body first (answering with the body unread could reset the connection; a missing or too large body -> 400/413), check the path (anything but /api/v1/entities -> 404), apply an injected delay or failure (with Retry-After), check the token (401), parse the JSON (400), then FakeLattice.publish decides (200, 400 for a broken entity, or 503 when the server has already stopped).
fn:ros2_ws/src/lattice_bridge/lattice_br.called_when: by do_PUT for every PUT request
fn:ros2_ws/src/lattice_bridge/lattice_br.effects: counters, journal lines, the HTTP answer

fn:ros2_ws/src/lattice_bridge/lattice_br.explain: Sends the 400 (unreadable length) or 413 (body above MAX_BODY_BYTES) that _read_body decided on, with {'message': 'the body is missing or too large'}; the body itself is never read.

fn:ros2_ws/src/lattice_bridge/test/conft.explain: Test helper: undoes the ROS launch library's change of Python's logger class (it makes every new logger a LaunchLogger that does not pass messages on), so the tests can read the bridge's log lines. Does nothing when ROS is not loaded.
